---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on **variable selection** and **prediction with multistate processes** under 
**complex observation schemes**. Applications includes identifying key risk factors 
from a large number of candidate variables.

My work includes both **methodological contributions**, where I develop statistical tools for 
multistate and survival data, and **applied collaborations** with clinician scientists to support 
clinical research. Feel free to check out my work on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.ca/citations?user=axUy9oAAAAAJ&hl=en).


## Recent papers and preprints

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(bib2df)
library(dplyr)
df <- bib2df(here::here("_biblio", "papers.bib"), separate_names = TRUE)

keep_fields <- toupper(c(
  "category", "author", "booktitle", "edition",
  "editor", "howpublished", "institution", 
  "journal", "pages", "publisher", "number",
  "title", "volume", "year", "arxiv", "url",
  "code", "pdf"))
df <- df[, keep_fields]

# df <- df[, keep_fields] |> arrange(desc(YEAR))
source(here::here("_rcode", "render-pubs.R"))

df2 <- df |>
  transmute(
    year = clean_str(YEAR),
    title = fmt_title(TITLE),
    pub = fmt_jvpy(CATEGORY, JOURNAL, BOOKTITLE, VOLUME, PAGES, year),
    links = fmt_links(URL, ARXIV, PDF, CODE),
    skip = is.na(URL) & is.na(ARXIV) & is.na(PDF) & is.na(CODE)
  )

bold_me <- function(x) {
  # Bold "Li, X" and "Li, X."
  x <- gsub("\\bLi, X\\b", "**Li, X**", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bLi, X\\.\\b", "**Li, X.**", x)
  x
}

df2$authors <- sapply(df$AUTHOR, function(a) bold_me(fmt_names(a)))
# df2$authors = sapply(df$AUTHOR, fmt_names)

df2 <- df2 |> filter(!skip)
```

```{r, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
for (i in 1:nrow(df2)) {
  ref = df2[i,]
  if (ref$skip) next
  cat(ref$title, "\n")
  cat(ref$authors, "\n")
  cat(ref$pub, "\n")
  cat(ref$links, "\n")
}
```
